headline: Sensex tumbles 931 points, Nifty plunges to 23,775 level amid fading confidence on ceasefire
summary: The BSE Sensex dropped 931 points in early trade, with the Nifty falling to 23,775 as confidence in the ceasefire faded. The index fell further after the opening bell.
why: The BSE Sensex tracks 30 major Indian companies and the Nifty tracks the National Stock Exchange's benchmark, both key gauges of Indian equity sentiment. Oil prices are a major factor for India as a large importer.

impacts.name: BSE Sensex
impacts.why: Fading confidence in the ceasefire pushed Indian equities lower in early trading.
